notes.title: Global update for the game
notes.content:
[h1]New gamemode[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850134/1a327d4e9caf7b9994491429039785320ad66934.jpg[/img]
Free mode. Where you can ride cars, have a row with NPCs, talk to them, destroy your own and AI cars. Also in the future, a storyline company designed for one person will unfold here. Everything will be in your hands, only freedom.
[previewyoutube=6Y9sX1nrX_s;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]New player customization[/h1]
We have added new character customization support, with which you can customize it in more detail.

[h1]Main menu additions[/h1]
A new game mode selection has been added. It has become more convenient and more beautiful both visually and technically.

[h3]Soon[/h3]
InGame world editor. Create your own modes using the tools built into the game, which will be in a separate DLC.

notes.title: Minor visual and technical changes
notes.content:
[i]Changed (football):
1. The rear view camera is now focused on the front of the car, not the back.
2. Fixed the work of the chat at the host.
3. The nickname bar has been changed.

Removed (football):
1. Gear display (not needed).

Added (global):
1. New main menu.
2. Voice chat.[/i]
